semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: Temporal marker indicating the date of the document or section, appearing in adjacent text boxes within paragraph 32.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: The node serves as a temporal anchor for the specific content block (paragraph 32) containing these occurrences. It establishes the validity or publication timeframe for the associated procedural information (Single-Stage Request for Proposals). The two occurrences are structurally split across adjacent text boxes but semantically identical, representing the same date reference.
